question: 不同型号的平均满意度和评价数
sql: SELECT p.model_code, ROUND(AVG(s.score),2) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS survey_count FROM satisfaction_surveys s JOIN tickets t ON t.id=s.ticket_id JOIN devices d ON d.id=t.device_id JOIN products p ON p.id=d.product_id GROUP BY p.model_code ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 200

question: 查看客户地址数量最多的前23个地区
sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM customer_addresses ca JOIN regions r ON r.id=ca.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY address_count DESC LIMIT 23

question: 统计2026-02-14以来各支付状态的订单数
sql: SELECT p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS order_count FROM payments p WHERE p.paid_at >= '2026-02-14' GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 200

question: 列出2026-02-15以来各故障代码的报修量
sql: SELECT fc.code, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM tickets t JOIN fault_codes fc ON fc.id=t.fault_code_id WHERE t.created_at >= '2026-02-15' GROUP BY fc.code ORDER BY ticket_count DESC LIMIT 200

question: 汇总2026-02-16以来工单状态变更事件
sql: SELECT te.to_status, COUNT(*) AS transition_count FROM ticket_events te WHERE te.occurred_at >= '2026-02-16' AND te.event_type='status_changed' GROUP BY te.to_status ORDER BY transition_count DESC LIMIT 200

question: 按仓库所在地区汇总单条库存不少于140件的库存量
sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS inventory_quantity FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=i.warehouse_id JOIN regions r ON r.id=w.region_id WHERE i.quantity >= 140 GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY inventory_quantity DESC LIMIT 200
